A [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] '''caliph''', a member of the [[Congress of Caliphs]], was the uncle of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Swokes Swokes named [[Choka Chok]]. When Chok was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Toro Irana]] at a [[Unidentified Makem Te restaurant|restaurant]] on the Swokes Swokes [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], his uncle complained to the [[New Jedi Order]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sent Irana's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mander Zuma]], to investigate the incident.<ref name="Scourge novel">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], Chapter 1</ref>
